title: Superman Returns Prequel #2 Ma Kent DC 2006 Bryan Singer Andreyko Kerschl
condition_description: Bright, clean covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Superman Returns Prequel #2 of 4: Ma Kent (August 2006), DC Comics - prequel to the Superman Returns film. Story by Bryan Singer, Michael Dougherty and Dan Harris; script by Marc Andreyko, art and cover by Karl Kerschl. Direct sales, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Disney/Pixar Cars videogame ad.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
